_comment: Metric catalogue for scripts/perf/compare.py. budget: allowed regression of the statistic against the baseline (0.10 = 10%); budget_abs, when set, an absolute allowance as well (the larger applies). ceiling: absolute limit, null when the memory budgets in scripts/memcheck.sh already cover it. gate: block fails the comparison, warn only reports.

metrics.what: start of main to the first drawn frame, welcome screen
start of main to the first window created
loading 100 installed, inactive extensions at startup (50 with code; none may start)
key press to the drawn frame, 10k-line Rust file with highlighting
key press to the drawn frame, 10k-line Rust file with highlighting and 2 decoration providers active (warn until the scenario is in run.sh)
provider platform overhead: request sent to an extension to its answer back in the window, trivial local provider (warn until the scenario is in run.sh)
Market search with 10 000 extensions: key press to the results in the view (searched off the UI thread)
Market search with 10 000 extensions: key press to the drawn frame showing the results
settled footprint, 10k-line Rust file with highlighting
